newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn to auction 6-mo Bubills, bids due Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Bonn to auction 6-mo Bubills, bids due Wednesday.

text.p: The German government on Tuesday set an auction for six-month German Treasury discount paper, or Bubills, with bids due by Wednesday, January 15 at 1000 GMT, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said.
The pay date is January 17 and the paper matures on July 18, 1997, the Bundesbank said.
The Bonn government's issuing calendar for the first quarter of 1997 says that up to 11 billion marks of Bubills will be issued.
